Subject: STAFF PLEASE READ........

A REMINDER to please let Sue on l.a.khdoralc@massey.ac.nz know if you are interested by tomorrow afternoon.   We need approximately 50 staff and/or students........




Want to be part of the action?  Then have we got an opportunity for you!  We need approximately 50 staff and/or students to take part in an Armed Offenders Squad (AOS) exercise on campus. Your role will be akin to an "extra" in a movie - e.g. part of the crowd milling around and subject at any time to becoming actively involved in "the real action"

Between approximately 5.00pm - 7.00pm, Wednesday 5th March (next Wednesday) the AOS will be conducting an active shooter exercise on the East precinct within the vicinity of the Sir Neil Waters Lecture Theatres building and the Atrium.

The campus emergency response team will be observing the exercise as part of their training should we ever be faced with a real active shooter scenario on campus. 

If you are interested in being part of the exercise next Wednesday, can you please email Sue l.a.khdoralc@massey.ac.nz to advise your availability.  

More information will be shared as we know more.



Andrea Davies, BBS,MBA
Regional Registrar Auckland
Albany Campus
Massey University
Private Bag 102 904
North Shore Mail Centre
09 4140800 extn 9516 or 021 246 2258
